Use this page to find maintained references for a study and keep its SCGSim package and PDK revisions paired. The [home page](../index.qmd#install) installs SCGSim `2.0.0rc15` at [`fb8cbe1`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/tree/fb8cbe199386bbe6d81cc9c58817fbe7d339573f) with the PDK revision below.

The public Xmon and CPW examples use OrPen SC PDK revision [`49e539f`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/49e539fd59f3224ecda965d777c7ec3aadcc3b85), distributed as `orcapen-sc-pdk` and imported as `orcapen_sc_pdk`. Use the pinned revision named by the example you follow.

## Keep source revisions paired

For Xmon and CPW, pair SCGSim `2.0.0rc15` with the pinned PDK revision above. The distribution name is `orcapen-sc-pdk`; Python imports use `orcapen_sc_pdk`. Keep each study's source revision in its environment and record.

The [historical Circular Pad setup](history/curved-source-installation.qmd) records a separate set of pinned SCGSim, PDK and native Palace revisions for that study. Use those pins when reproducing that specific run. The PDK revisions that study and the guides pinned to SCGSim `2.0.0rc11` name use the package's earlier names, `orpen-sc-pdk` and `orpen_sc_pdk`.

## Native and offline EPR steps

`analyze_epr` evaluates retained saved fields through native AEDT and requires an explicitly selected AEDT release and license. `reanalyze_epr` updates assumptions on a resolved EPR result offline. Follow the complete [saved-field lesson](course/aedt-saved-fields.qmd), then use the [generated API reference](api/analyze_epr.qmd) for its callable signature.

## Junction capacitance reference

For one junction in a given mode and pass, $V$ is its complex peak-phasor voltage and $U_{norm}$ is the electric-energy normalization, not total electric-plus-magnetic energy. For nonzero $V$, the effective modal capacitance is $C_{mode}=2U_{norm}/|V|^2$, the branch capacitance is $C_j=2U_{C,j}/|V|^2$, and the participation ratio is $p_{C,j}=C_j/C_{mode}$. At $V=0$, the ratio is undefined. The [AEDT runtime contract](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#surface-estimates-and-junction-normalization) records the full voltage, energy and normalization definitions.
